description: Create a draft of a physical letter to be printed on paper and mailed through USPS, and return its draft_id, page count and total price. A letter is at most 6 printed pages, at the same price whatever its length: up to 3 pages print one-sided, 4 to 6 print on both sides. Write the body to fit, or split a longer document into two letters, because a body that renders to 7 or more pages is refused rather than trimmed. This is NOT email, fax or text message — nothing reaches the recipient electronically, and the only way this letter arrives is on paper in an envelope. The body is plain text or Markdown. The draft freezes the content and the price for 24 hours and costs nothing; no paper is printed and no postage is bought until send_letter is called. US domestic addresses only. Call preview_draft next so the user can see the letter and the total.

body_file.description: A file the user attached, as the host delivers it. Not accepted yet — create_draft refuses an attachment and asks for the letter as body_markdown text.

download_url.description: A short-lived URL the file can be fetched from.

file_id.description: The host's identifier for the uploaded file.

file_name.description: The name the file was uploaded under.

mime_type.description: The file's media type, e.g. application/pdf.

body_markdown.description: The text of the letter, as plain text or Markdown. It must render to 6 printed pages or fewer — roughly 2,400 words of body text.

colour.description: Omit this. The current price card prints every letter black & white, so passing true is refused rather than billed — call get_pricing for what it does sell. The field remains because letters priced on an older card carry it.

from_address_id.description: Omit this. The account's own verified return address is used by default; only pass an id the account holder gave you.

tier.description: Defaults to standard. Call get_pricing first and pass a tier it lists: standard is a plain First-Class letter. certified, certified_err, proof_of_mailing and registered are other products the current price card may not sell, and a tier it does not sell is refused, not substituted — so do not describe one to the user until get_pricing has listed it.

to.description: Who the letter is mailed to.

line1.description: Street number and street name, or PO box.

name.description: The person or company the letter is addressed to.

postal_code.description: Five-digit ZIP or ZIP+4, such as 10001 or 10001-2345.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code, such as NY.

name: create_draft

draft_id.description: Pass this to preview_draft, update_draft and send_letter.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 instant the draft is deleted. Nothing is charged if it expires.

included_pages.description: Printed pages the headline price covers. This draft is priced at that total up to this many pages.

note.description: The next call to make. Read it before answering the user.

page_count.description: Printed pages, as counted by the renderer. Never more than 6 — a longer body is refused.

quote.description: A priced letter. State total.display to the user before sending, and pass total.amount_cents as confirm_total_cents.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 instant after which this total is re-computed from the live price card. Call preview_draft for a fresh quote before sending if it has passed.

quote_id.description: Identifier for this quote, for support and receipts.

subtotal.description: What the letter costs, before sales tax.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

collected.description: New York sales tax on this letter. We mail from New York, so a few cents apply wherever the letter goes, and more when it is going to New York.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

total.description: Subtotal plus sales tax. This is the number send_letter requires in confirm_total_cents.

amount_cents.description: The amount in whole US cents.

display.description: The amount formatted for a person, with a currency symbol.

version.description: The published price card this total came from.

sheet_count.description: Sheets of paper this letter is printed on: one page per sheet, one side each, up to 3 pages; a letter of 4 to 6 pages is printed on both sides, so it is never more than 3 sheets.

tier.description: The product this draft is priced as, as passed to create_draft or update_draft.

tier_title.description: What the price card in force calls that product, such as Standard. Use this name when you tell the user what they are buying.

title: Create a Letter Draft
